advice: When spec attribute uses {type: int, foreign_key: ...}, migration_generator must emit sa.Integer() + ForeignKey constraint — NOT sa.String(255). Root cause: _sqla_col() read 'type_hint' key only; 'type' key was silently ignored. Fix: check both keys in PYTYPE_TO_SQLA lookup. See migration_generator.py:_sqla_col + test_migration_generator_plain_type_key_not_string255.

README header version, status table version, CHANGELOG current marker, and plugin.json must agree. Pre-commit sync_docs.py hook patches them; CI compliance_audit.py greps for the pattern. Do not hand-maintain version numbers in multiple docs.

Tests that grep SKILL.md for specific strings break when SKILL.md is split into stage files. Use conftest.py pipeline_text() which reads SKILL.md + all stages/*.md as one body. Do NOT hardcode SKILL.read_text() in new tests.

Mutation testing on macOS (APFS) and fast SSDs: mtime granularity < 1s means mutated .py shares mtime with stale .pyc, causing pytest to import cached bytecode (original code) and miss the mutation. Fix: _clear_pycache(project) before each subprocess + set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. See mutation_tester.py:_run_tests.

When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY missing, live_api_runner returns reason='missing_anthropic_api_key'. But when the anthropic SDK itself isn't installed, returns 'anthropic_sdk_not_installed' first. CI must install 'anthropic' explicitly in pip install line, or tests asserting the API-key reason will see the SDK reason instead.

A harness with .claude/hooks/ but no .claude/settings.json has dead hooks — they never fire. Every harness ships with settings.json wiring PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart matchers. Copy from .claude/settings.json as the template.

Listing agents in a CLAUDE.md table as 'For code review → /call:reviewer' makes them feel optional. Claude reads tables as reference, not as instructions. Use 'Default agent behaviour — READ THIS FIRST' section with 'Automatic review rule: after every code write, invoke the reviewer agent immediately.' Agents must be declared as the default, not a menu item.

Claiming 'X skills are integrated into pipeline stages' is overclaim if the stage files don't actually invoke them. Either wire them with @./../../skill/SKILL.md calls + explicit trigger conditions, or downgrade the claim. Enforce with tests that grep stage files for the skill name. See test_mattpocock_skill_wiring.py for the pattern.

Tests checking 'v3.5.0 in marketplace.md' break the moment you bump the version. Use a regex like re.search(r'v\d+\.\d+\.\d+', text) so the test verifies 'has a version string', not 'has this specific version'. Same pattern for ANY version-specific assertion in tests against docs.

Files like IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, VALIDATION_REPORT.md, scorecard-vN.md are point-in-time snapshots that drift every release. Either auto-regenerate via CI or archive to .archive/stale-snapshots/. Do not hand-maintain them. Single source of truth = CHANGELOG.md.
